name: code-review-graph
description: Builds a local Tree-sitter graph of a codebase and serves blast-radius and risk-scored review context to coding agents over MCP, plus a CLI and a GitHub Action for pull requests.

skills.name: Blast-Radius Analysis
skills.description: Traces every caller, dependent, and test a changed file could affect, so the assistant reads those files instead of the whole project.

skills.name: Risk-Scored Reviews
skills.description: Maps a diff to affected functions, execution flows, and test gaps with detect_changes, and scores each change by risk for review.

skills.name: PR Review Action
skills.description: Runs the analysis as a GitHub Action that posts one sticky risk-scored comment per pull request, with an optional fail-on-risk gate.

skills.name: Incremental Graph Updates
skills.description: Keeps the graph current through editor hooks, a git pre-commit hook, and watch mode, re-parsing only files whose hash has changed.

skills.name: Architecture Overview
skills.description: Clusters the graph into communities with Leiden and produces an architecture map with coupling warnings, hubs, and bridge nodes.
